archetypes.name: dyn-guidelines-pin
archetypes.rationale: Changed no-delta rebase and pending-retry paths from unconditional invalidation to pin-first fallback.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed architectural-guidelines pin-before-invalidate flow. Check that each no-delta caller resolves HEAD after the rebase or immediately before pending retry push, passes the qualified base ref, and preserves the warning boolean contract when falling back to invalidation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
